note: Per-asset waivers, each one a measured value and a reason. An entry here does NOT switch a check off: the check still runs, still measures, and `assets:validate` prints the asset as `warn` rather than `ok`. `assets:report` counts them and the count is part of the asset state in PROJECT_MEMORY. Adding an entry is a deliberate act with a date against it; a new asset that fails the same check is still a failure until somebody writes it down here. Raised by ADR-013.

exceptions.measured: upper-left mean 154.3 vs lower-right 168.8 (delta -14.5) — the key light is not coming from the upper left (ASSET_PIPELINE §1.1 LIGHT: single key from the north-west, 35 degrees)
exceptions.reason: Delivered art, accepted under ADR-013. exceptions.measured: reference-height: 171px exceeds the 125px projected box +15% = 144px (ASSET_PIPELINE §1.2 (50 px ≈ 0.78 m))
exceptions.reason: Delivered art, accepted under ADR-013. The set is drawn at a shallower camera than the world's 2:1 dimetric, so a subject's silhouette is taller relative to its width than the projection predicts. `assets:import` fits sprites to the projected WIDTH because the footprint is what parks, queues and sorts; the height then overflows by the amount the camera differs. Measured overflow here is under 40%, which reads as an object standing slightly proud of its own ground diamond rather than as a wrong object.

exceptions.measured: mean distance 52.5 over 6717 interior pixels; random colour would be 51.5 — this asset is no closer to the palette than an arbitrary image, so it carries none of the project's colour identity (furthest pixel 99)
exceptions.reason: Genuinely off-family, and recorded as such rather than waved through. The UI icon batch was generated in saturated primaries where the rest of the set lives in the palette's muted ramps, and these sit at or past the random-colour baseline — the check is right. The art ships unchanged by the 2026-08-18 decision (ADR-013 §4); the fix is a regenerated icon set drawn against the `neutral`, `foliage` and `amber` ramps, not a threshold. Tracked as an art gap.

The check splits the alpha bounding box on its anti-diagonal, which biases against light-bodied and diagonally-massed silhouettes: the same rig part passes facing se/nw and fails facing ne/sw, and every vehicle that fails is a near-white body whose windscreen and headlights fall in the lower-right half of the box. A visual review of the worst eight found no relit asset in the set — the key light is consistent, the instrument is not.

exceptions.measured: mean distance 55.8 over 6825 interior pixels; random colour would be 51.5 — this asset is no closer to the palette than an arbitrary image, so it carries none of the project's colour identity (furthest pixel 94)
exceptions.reason: Genuinely off-family, and recorded as such rather than waved through. The UI icon batch was generated in saturated primaries where the rest of the set lives in the palette's muted ramps, and these sit at or past the random-colour baseline — the check is right. The art ships unchanged by the 2026-08-18 decision (ADR-013 §4); the fix is a regenerated icon set drawn against the `neutral`, `foliage` and `amber` ramps, not a threshold. Tracked as an art gap.
